description: This PHP class 'LinkFieldName' extends 'BaseOption' and is part of the 'Api\V8\Param\Options' namespace. It defines a method 'add' which configures an OptionsResolver to set requirements, allowed types, and validation for the 'linkFieldName' parameter, including normalization that loads a relationship from a bean and throws an exception if unsuccessful.
